other_failure_modes.name: Missing Validation Score Reporting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent performs cross-validation and trains models on the folds, but fails to calculate, log, or report any validation metric (e.g., RMSE) for the out-of-fold predictions. This makes it impossible to assess model generalisation performance without submitting to an external leaderboard.

summary: The agent provides a structurally sound script with correct data leakage prevention during imputation and appropriate model choices for regression. However, it lacks any feature engineering, ignores potential temporal aspects of the financial data by using a random split, applies a naive ensembling method, and completely fails to compute or report any internal validation metrics during cross-validation.
